confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are the least certain: they are set for July peak season in Split and may vary widely by property and exact dates. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weak. FX is unverified: search summaries attributed 0.6955 USD per AUD to the RBA homepage for 2026-10-15, but I could not open the RBA page to confirm it, and a third-party source gives 0.6947 for 2026-10-16. Check the RBA F11.1 daily table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of summer pricing in Split and comparable Croatian Adriatic destinations such as Dubrovnik and Zadar, adjusted for Split's mid-sized urban and old-town mix. July is peak season, so accommodation anchors reflect high-season rates.
